name: Satani Bearings Limited
about: Satani Bearings Limited engages in the trading of bearings in India and internationally. It is involved in the business of business of ball and roller bearings for use in automobiles, pumps, gear boxes, heavy earth moving equipment, and industrial sectors. The company was formerly known as Deccan Bearings Limited and changed its name to Satani Bearings Limited in January 2026. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Rajkot, India.
